topic: How strong the command log's tamper evidence should be
detail: SP-014's chain detects modified, deleted and reordered records, but the anchors live in toollog.db itself: records removed after the last anchor, or a chain rewritten from its first record, cannot be detected, and task chains are never anchored (tasks send no SessionEnd). Options: copy each anchor's (seq, hash) into orch.db or another store the guard protects (SP-042), anchor a task's chain when it reaches a terminal state, or accept file-level tamper evidence and rely on the OS sandbox (SP-046) to keep sessions out of the file.
note: Settled by the user on 2026-11-10: anchors copied into orch.db and task chains anchored at their end; see D-35 and SP-073.
